meta.title: Zhipu MCP Suite
meta.description: Zhipu MCP suite (web search / reader / zread) as native DSH providers and tools, with a settings card.

en.credentialRefDesc: Credential reference of the Zhipu Coding Plan API key (default ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY).
en.enabledDesc: Master switch: off enters search/reader compatibility fallbacks and unregisters repo tools; this form stays.
en.invalid: Credential reference must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
en.readerDesc: Replaces the built-in web_fetch backend with the Zhipu reader MCP (markdown). Web presets ship web_fetch by default since DSH v0.1.2, so it takes effect once mounted; turning this off uses a bounded HTTP(S) text fetch.
en.readOnly: The settings document is read-only; changes cannot be saved.
en.saveNotApplied: The host did not accept all settings; the draft was kept.
en.searchDesc: Replaces the built-in web_search backend with the Zhipu search MCP. When off, it uses the DSH DeepSeek request shape (credential DEEPSEEK_API_KEY).
en.summary: Where web search, web reader and repo tools (github_*) come from, and their credential.
en.unavailable: Zhipu tools settings are unavailable in this deployment.
en.zhPromptDesc: When on, injected system-prompt sections, github_* tool descriptions and their error messages use Chinese (English by default, matching built-in tools).
